issues.problem: The S6 timer park does not wait until the record is DURABLE (HLD-62). Its postpone list covers only a FREEZE reason, a fence/lease/TXN, an open CS and a failed writer CAS. It does not cover the OFFLINE/AUTH publish pause, which glossary §8 says is not a FREEZE, and it does not cover a record shown as HOLD_MIRROR_REJECTED. Parking can therefore move a record's only off-disk copy into the unmirrored local registry ref. The claim "and on the board" is then false, and the parked bytes are in none of the places INV-NOLOSS lists in its "exactly one of" set. It also contradicts 08-lifecycle §8 Q5 (line 1089), which says of a HOLD_MIRROR_REJECTED record: "Nothing is parked or lost meanwhile."
issues.evidence: Counterexample 1: a peer holds an ON_DISK K4 PATCH (local_only=false) and loses network for more than 24 h. The OFFLINE pause is not a FREEZE (glossary §8), so HLD-61 parks the record. Disk returns to TIP, the record becomes OFF_DISK PARKED, and its hold op has never landed (HLD-62: not durable). The local bytes now exist only in refs/cowork-local/<b>/holds. INV-NOLOSS (glossary §21) lists the live chain, the saved branch, a board-mirrored record, a local_only record, an undisplaced edit on disk, or RESOLVED_DISCARD, and this location is none of them. Counterexample 2: a record whose hold op the fold rejects (HOLD_MIRROR_REJECTED, glossary §9) can never become durable, yet with local_only=false it is parked 24 h later. LIF-32 refuses `stop` during OFFLINE and on non-durable records, but nothing gives the timer park the same durability gate.
issues.fix: Add "the record is not DURABLE (HLD-62), including HOLD_MIRROR_REJECTED" to HLD-61's postpone list, so S6 parks only records whose current rev is on the remote board. Change the bullet to "The bytes stay in the registry and in the durable board mirror."
